use.title: Use alerts
use.description: Get alerts in the inbox and send them to your own channels.

onboarding.featureDesc: Every alert in one inbox, sent on to Discord, ntfy, email or a webhook if you want.

announcements.label: Termix announcements
announcements.description: Show news from the Termix team, like security notices and releases, in everyone's inbox.

retentionDays.label: Keep alerts for (days)
retentionDays.description: Older alerts are removed from every inbox.

smtpHost.label: SMTP server
smtpHost.description: Needed for email channels. Leave empty to turn email off.

smtpPort.label: SMTP port
smtpPort.description: Usually 587 with STARTTLS or 465 with TLS.

smtpSecure.label: Use TLS from the start
smtpSecure.description: Turn on for port 465. Leave off for 587, which upgrades to TLS on its own.

smtpUser.label: SMTP username
smtpUser.description: Leave empty if the server does not need a login.

popups.label: Alert popups
popups.description: Which new alerts pop up while you use Termix. They always land in the inbox.

channels.intro: Channels are where alerts can go outside Termix. Delivery rules pick which alerts use them.
channels.needsSave: This channel needs to be opened and saved again before it can send.
channels.name: Name
channels.emailUnavailable: Email needs an SMTP server, which an admin sets up in the Alerts settings.
channels.webhookHint: Gets a JSON body for every alert.
channels.headersHint: One per line, like Name: value.
channels.discordHint: From the channel's settings in Discord, under Integrations.
channels.emailHint: Separate more than one address with commas.
channels.privateNetworkHint: Only works for hosts an admin allows in the private endpoint list.

rules.intro: A delivery rule sends matching alerts to your channels. Alerts always stay in the inbox too.
rules.empty: No rules yet, so alerts only show up in the inbox.
rules.name: Name
rules.matchHint: * for everything, automations.* for everything from automations, or one exact kind.
